exclusion_rules.description: List of exclusion rules to apply before the CRS. Each rule defines how and which CRS rules should be suppressed.

id.description: Optional unique rule ID. If omitted, auto-generated as 1000 + index.

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule's purpose.

uri_pattern.description: Regex pattern for REQUEST_URI to match (used when `condition=uri`).

header_name.description: HTTP header name to inspect (used when `condition=header`).

header_value_pattern.description: Regex to match against header value (used when `condition=header`).

variable_name.description: ModSecurity variable (e.g., ARGS, ARGS_GET) to match (used when `condition=variable`).

match_pattern.description: Regex pattern for the variable (used when `condition=variable`).

uri_regex.description: Regex for REQUEST_URI to match, for `rule_by_id` exclusions (used when `condition=rule_by_id`).

filename_pattern.description: Regex for REQUEST_FILENAME to match, for tag-based exclusions (used when `condition=action`).

target_rule_ids.description: List of CRS rule IDs to exclude from matching when condition matches (used for `ruleRemoveTargetById`).

remove_ids.description: List of specific rule IDs to disable entirely on match (used for `ruleRemoveById`).

remove_tags.description: List of rule tags (e.g., `attack-sqli`, `attack-xss`) to disable entirely on match (used for `ruleRemoveByTag`).

target_args.description: List of argument names to exclude from specific rules (e.g., `ARGS:password`) — passed via `ctl:ruleRemoveTargetById=...;ARGS:foo` syntax.
